title: Extrafoliaceous
summary: EXTRAFOLIA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin extra, on the outside, and folium, a leaf.] In botany, growing on the outside of a leaf; as extrafoliaceous stipules.

inlines.v: EXTRAFOLIA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin extra, on the outside, and folium, a leaf.] In botany, growing on the outside of a leaf; as extrafoliaceous stipules.
